scope_requirements.name: Two-process runtime
scope_requirements.boundary: `ovs-webd` 非特权；`ovs-mgrd` 为 typed privileged helper；Unix socket；protocol/version handshake。

scope_requirements.name: Field/Domain Authority
scope_requirements.boundary: OVSDB、OpenFlow、rtnetlink、ethtool/sysfs/devlink、appctl 等按 Domain Field 定义 Authority/source/provenance/freshness。

scope_requirements.name: OVS Semantic Operation Layer
scope_requirements.boundary: libovsdb 上层实现 OVS 原生对象语义；禁止 generic CRUD 直接暴露到 Domain/API。

scope_requirements.name: Schema/Capability Discovery
scope_requirements.boundary: 启动和重连时读取 schema constraints/capability；功能由 capability 决定而非 distro/版本字符串硬编码。

scope_requirements.name: Dual SQLite
scope_requirements.boundary: web.db 保存用户意图/UI metadata；manager.db 保存安全权威、事务、Audit、lifecycle；不做跨库 2PC。

scope_requirements.name: SecretStore
scope_requirements.boundary: 不可逆 credential 只存 hash；可复用 secret 用 AEAD；按消费者权限分区；API write-only/replace-only。

scope_requirements.name: Candidate Workspace
scope_requirements.boundary: server-persisted、per-user、base revision + typed ChangeSet；浏览器关闭可恢复。

scope_requirements.name: OCC / Safe Apply / Rollback
scope_requirements.boundary: 字段级 CAS；高风险操作 Safe Apply；compare-before-rollback；支持 Rollback Conflict。

scope_requirements.name: Commit vs Applied
scope_requirements.boundary: OVSDB commit 与 ovs-vswitchd applied 分离；使用 next_cfg/cur_cfg 或等价 Applied evidence。

scope_requirements.name: OutcomeUnknown recovery
scope_requirements.boundary: commit reply 丢失时进入 OutcomeUnknown，resync/reconcile 后判定，不盲目 retry。

scope_requirements.name: Instance Generation
scope_requirements.boundary: 识别新/同一 OVSDB generation；旧 Candidate/Profile/Safe Apply 不跨 generation 静默执行。

scope_requirements.name: Bounded resource/backpressure
scope_requirements.boundary: 所有 cache/queue/query/output 有界；关键配置路径优先；Degraded Management Mode。

scope_requirements.name: Bridge / Port / Interface
scope_requirements.boundary: 完整 CRUD/关联管理；保留 Bridge→Port→Interface；Standard/Expert 双视图；Create/Delete 服从 strong reference、local internal interface、immutable name 等 OVS 语义。

scope_requirements.name: VLAN
scope_requirements.boundary: Access、Trunk、Native VLAN Trunk；Native egress Tagged/Untagged；Advanced 暴露 QinQ/dot1q-tunnel；保留 tag/trunks/cvlans/vlan_mode。

scope_requirements.name: Bond / LACP
scope_requirements.boundary: active-backup、balance-slb、balance-tcp；member add/remove；LACP active/passive/off；校验 balance-tcp/LACP/fallback/flood_vlans 等 OVS 约束。

scope_requirements.name: STP / RSTP
scope_requirements.boundary: Bridge enable/disable、root/priority/status、基础 Port cost/priority/edge；STP/RSTP 互斥；明确 unsupported port 和 upstream caveat。

scope_requirements.name: IGMP / MLD Snooping
scope_requirements.boundary: 基础 enable/status、group/port 视图和 OVS 原生基础配置；不做高级 multicast policy。

scope_requirements.name: Port Profile / Drift
scope_requirements.boundary: managed_fields、revision/applied_revision、per-port override、Drift、Accept Current/Reapply/Detach；不自动 reconcile。

scope_requirements.name: Mirror / SPAN
scope_requirements.boundary: MirrorSession 一等对象；仅 OVS 原生 source/destination/VLAN 能力；Packet Capture 归 Diagnostics。

scope_requirements.name: QoS / Queue
scope_requirements.boundary: OVS 原生 QoS/Queue 关系、基础 rate 参数、统计；未知 other_config 保留；无高层 policy compiler。

scope_requirements.name: Tunnel
scope_requirements.boundary: 静态 VXLAN/Geneve/GRE 等 capability-driven CRUD；`remote_ip=flow`/`key=flow`/controller-owned 默认只读。

scope_requirements.name: Protected Port / Isolation
scope_requirements.boundary: 只开放当前 OVS 原生 protected/isolation 能力；不模拟 Port Security/DHCP Snooping/DAI/Storm Control。

scope_requirements.name: OpenFlow
scope_requirements.boundary: flows/groups/meters/controller/table viewer；仅明确 local-managed bridge 允许 raw Expert 修改；controller-owned/unknown ownership 只读。

scope_requirements.name: DPDK
scope_requirements.boundary: enabled/datapath/ports/devargs/NUMA/hugepages/PMD/CPU/RXQ/drops/offload；不提供 enable、driver bind 或完整 tuning。

scope_requirements.name: Hardware Offload / SmartNIC
scope_requirements.boundary: PF/VF/representor、capability、configured/active/partial/fallback/failure/stats；不执行 switchdev/SR-IOV restructuring。

scope_requirements.name: sFlow / NetFlow / IPFIX
scope_requirements.boundary: OVS 原生 exporter config/state/diagnostics；不提供 collector、存储或时序分析。

scope_requirements.name: Endpoint / FDB / ARP/ND / LLDP
scope_requirements.boundary: 本机 MAC/FDB/neighbour/可观察 LLDP，global search 与一跳 Local Topology；不做 CMDB/资产库/递归发现。

scope_requirements.name: Management Interface
scope_requirements.boundary: 显式创建/迁移；物理口加入 Bridge 时将 host IP/routes 迁移到 internal interface；必须 Safe Apply + reachability check。

scope_requirements.name: Unified State Cache
scope_requirements.boundary: 事件驱动优先、分级轮询补充；每字段 source/provenance/timestamp/freshness；RAM-only。

scope_requirements.name: Event Timeline
scope_requirements.boundary: 仅持久化有运维意义的状态变化；dedupe/coalesce/flap count；Event 与 Audit 分离。

scope_requirements.name: Health Engine
scope_requirements.boundary: Healthy/Degraded/Critical/Unknown；确定性、可解释；不做黑盒评分。

scope_requirements.name: Diagnostics
scope_requirements.boundary: Connectivity / OVS / Hardware / Services typed operations；Read-only/Active/Disruptive 风险分层；无任意 shell。

scope_requirements.name: Packet Capture
scope_requirements.boundary: 作为临时 Diagnostic Job；有 timeout/size/cancel；不与持久 Mirror 混为一类。

scope_requirements.name: Support Bundle
scope_requirements.boundary: OVS-centric bundle：OVS/config/state、相关 Linux 网络/硬件、Health/Event/Audit/transactions/capabilities；中央脱敏。

scope_requirements.name: Self-Observability
scope_requirements.boundary: 结构化日志→journald；webd/mgrd/DB/SecretStore/Provider/queue/resource health；受控 Debug Mode。

scope_requirements.name: Pagination / streaming
scope_requirements.boundary: flows/FDB/conntrack/events/audit/jobs/endpoints 等大集合支持 cursor pagination；重输出可 streaming/truncated。

scope_requirements.name: Local authentication
scope_requirements.boundary: 至少一个 break-glass admin；password verifier 由 manager.db/ovs-mgrd 权威管理；Argon2id。

scope_requirements.name: TACACS+
scope_requirements.boundary: Phase 1 外部 AAA provider；AAA 自身配置必须可 test/confirm，不能删除最后可用登录路径。

scope_requirements.name: RBAC / Capability
scope_requirements.boundary: Role→Capability；mgrd 最终 enforcement；webd 只能前置检查，不能自行铸造 privileged authorization。

scope_requirements.name: Auth Grant / Session
scope_requirements.boundary: 浏览器 session 与 mgrd-issued auth grant 关联；高风险 re-auth 创建短时 elevated grant。

scope_requirements.name: API Token
scope_requirements.boundary: 一次显示 plaintext；持久只存 hash/scope/owner/expiry/last-use metadata；支持 revoke。

scope_requirements.name: HTTPS
scope_requirements.boundary: HTTPS 默认；bootstrap self-signed；证书 candidate validate/activate；trusted reverse proxy；same-origin CORS。

scope_requirements.name: Secret handling
scope_requirements.boundary: SECRET 不通过 GET 回显；中央 redaction 应用于 API/Audit/Event/log/Support Bundle/export。

scope_requirements.name: Audit Core
scope_requirements.boundary: 所有管理操作、结果、外部检测到的 config change 结构化审计；actor 不可证明时 External/Unknown。

scope_requirements.name: REST API v1
scope_requirements.boundary: `/api/v1/...`；正式 UI 所有生产管理动作可通过公共 API 完成。

scope_requirements.name: OpenAPI
scope_requirements.boundary: 随版本发布；作为兼容性契约；同 major additive-only。

scope_requirements.name: WebSocket
scope_requirements.boundary: 仅 realtime state/event/progress；不作为普通 RPC 或唯一 Job 状态源。

scope_requirements.name: Error Model
scope_requirements.boundary: 稳定 HTTP status + machine code + details + correlation_id。

scope_requirements.name: Idempotency
scope_requirements.boundary: 适用写操作支持 Idempotency-Key/天然幂等；不替代 OVSDB OutcomeUnknown reconciliation。

scope_requirements.name: Async Job
scope_requirements.boundary: 长操作 202 + job_id；REST Job resource 权威；支持 cancel（能力允许时）。

scope_requirements.name: External platform boundary
scope_requirements.boundary: 允许外部 Controller/Orchestrator 调用 API；本项目不反向依赖 ESXi/Proxmox/OpenStack/K8s 专有 API。

scope_requirements.name: OVS Lifecycle
scope_requirements.boundary: 识别 OVS version/source、available update、preflight、async upgrade、daemon transition、schema/capability rediscovery、health validation。

scope_requirements.name: Lifecycle provider boundary
scope_requirements.boundary: 只管理 OVS；不修改 Linux repo、不升级 kernel/OS；custom/unknown source 可 observe-only。

scope_requirements.name: Checkpoint
scope_requirements.boundary: 单个 rolling Last Known Good；只有成功/确认事务更新；独立文件+checksum/manifest。

scope_requirements.name: Config Export/Import
scope_requirements.boundary: deterministic Git-friendly export；默认 Merge + diff；Exact Restore 高风险；secrets 缺失不清空。

scope_requirements.name: Management Backup/Restore
scope_requirements.boundary: 备份 web.db/manager.db/management config/history/checkpoint/SecretStore ciphertext/manifest；默认不含 master key。

scope_requirements.name: Reconciliation after restore
scope_requirements.boundary: 恢复或重装后重新识别 OVS generation；不得自动重放旧配置。

scope_requirements.name: WebUI service recovery
scope_requirements.boundary: systemd supervision；mgrd pending transaction 从 durable journal 恢复；manager.db 异常进入 fail-safe degraded/read-only。
